`DOCTRINE.take` (70 metal · 20 wood · 30 provisions, five shields, 120 s on the real road, casualty 0.45) gated on the mountain road — Farkeep takes no ground it cannot reach.

figure.record: 70 metal · 20 wood · 30 provisions, five shields, 120 s on the real road, casualty 0.45
figure.note: the row reads every one of them; a real click pays exactly 70, 20 and 30 and five shields march for 120 s

clauses.text: on arrival the camp is HELD: a REPUBLIC WATCHPOST (`WATCHPOST` row) with two shields standing the fire

figure.note: the held camp's post stands exactly two shields, and the row says two

clauses.text: under Farkeep's grey pennant, tents pitched in mountain grey
a salvage tithe hauled in from the ring (a crate per 90 s, capped at four, carried off by the prompt at the post)

figure.record: a crate per 90 s, capped at four
figure.note: one crate at each 90 s turn of the clock — 1, 2, 3, 4, then 4 and 4 — all four carried off at the post

clauses.text: a HELD RING — a chase that crosses into 0.7 of the old claim is broken by the post

figure.note: the row reads 0.7, and the chase breaks within twenty units inside 0.7 of the claim

clauses.text: (the runner cools twelve seconds and turns back to his own ring; proven on a temporary camp row, since the world's own camps stand too far apart to cross)

figure.note: the broken runner reads a cooldown of 11 s or more at the step after the break, and walks back out

clauses.text: a raider truce, if one stood, DIES with the first shield in the ring
the nearest town breathes easier (+6)

figure.note: the town nearest the Pass is exactly six likes warmer

clauses.text: the mountain may pay a name (the casualty roll raises a Standing Teeth stone — `casualtyRoll` now serves the quell and the taking alike)
the RAIDER REPRISAL fires — a 420 s season in which every camp that stands claims 1.25× wider and runs 1.15× quicker

figure.note: the season opens at 420 s and reads its multipliers 1.25 and 1.15 (the rows' numbers; the wider claim and quicker run are not measured on the ground)

clauses.text: a camp the wire reaches still stands down by ITSELF with its gift, and a held camp is never counted twice (`pacified` is the quiet flag; `taken` is how)
the bowl goes cold with a scorch on the ground (a third shrine glyph), and the Flame Keepers ASK — an entry under THE WORLD ASKS on the banner sheet that AGES (600 s)

figure.note: the ask is 600 s long, and outlived by a second it lapses

clauses.text: feed the bowl again by hand and the question closes warm
let it lapse and the Keepers' stance cools a step and they say so
a hooded stake stands where he stood and the camp restaffs one knife short for a day

figure.note: a knife short straight after the cull, whole again a day and a second on; the day's edge is not sampled

clauses.text: when the rising's pressure passes 55 % of its period the Unlit TALK to the town they will take next

figure.note: the courting row reads 0.55 (the courting itself is fired here at 0.6 of the period)

clauses.text: a half-flown shutter beside its door
HEAR THEM OUT on the sheet (8 provisions, 20 likes at their door)

figure.note: eight provisions paid exactly (100 → 92); the twenty likes as a bound — the town at 10 will not sit, at 30 it hears them

clauses.text: the drum drops 45 % of a period, the courting clears, the town warms

figure.note: the pressure drops by 0.45 of the period to 0.01

clauses.text: ignored, the rising takes the courted town FIRST
sixteen lore pairs (`RELATIONS.base`, keyed on the sorted pair, deltas in the save)

figure.note: seventeen since v3.41 (the Society's door); the check asserts seventeen, each keyed on the sorted pair

clauses.text: read in five bands (WAR · FEUD · COLD · TRUCE · ALLIED) with a line each and "last moved by …" — under THE WORLD'S OWN WARS on the sheet

figure.note: the bands read WAR, FEUD, COLD, TRUCE, ALLIED, each pair in its band with its line

clauses.text: the Society and the Nomads stand ALLIED ("one fire, two banners")
go to WAR with the first taking
Every place the table knows now carries its OWNER on the plate
TAKE stands on every raider camp, disabled with the gate line until the road is cut.

FARKEEP — THE LONG HALL (stone) enters from Farkeep's desk: the SHIELD WALL hangs a darkened shield for every stone at the Standing Teeth and reads the fallen by name; the hearth tells the founding in three fragments (the famine, the descent, and THE CHILD carried down the pass "grey-eyed, and it did not cry once in the dark" — the warden looks a beat too long); the practice yard hires the kit from its rows on three keys.

SHUTTERLIGHT — THE GUILD ROOM (timber) enters from the Shutterlight desk: the board reads the Nomads' opinion of you, the counter sells .338 across the exchange, and the hooded lantern tells three fragments (the hood, the sword, and THE MARK cut under the lip "in a hand you know — the same hand that signs your manifests"; "Some exiles are born. Some are only late.").
Rooms now carry a `style` (a `ROOM_STYLES` material table: concrete, stone, timber — one renderer, three materials) and an `exitLine` in their own voice.
every room row is now ≤ 400×190 so it stands whole down to a 1280×720 viewport

figure.note: every room row is at most 400×190, and at a 1280×720 viewport each stands whole on screen

clauses.text: the title sits on the ceiling band, and the walker inside is the rig itself in the coat it wears — no stand-in figure down there either
